name: Vex System Monitor
author: jd
description: Consolidated system monitor with CPU/GPU/RAM/Swap/Disk meters, fan monitoring, thermal envelope with color gradient, and hardware autodetection. Features a settings GUI with gear icon for modular feature toggles.

settings.label: Color Mode
settings.description: Theme uses Omarchy accent/urgent colors, Custom uses green/red gradient

settings.label: Fast Polling
settings.description: 3 seconds (fast) or 6 seconds (slow) update interval

settings.label: CPU Meter
settings.description: Show/hide CPU usage meter

settings.label: GPU Meter
settings.description: Show/hide GPU usage meter

settings.label: NPU Meter
settings.description: Show/hide NPU usage meter

settings.label: RAM Meter
settings.description: Show/hide RAM usage meter

settings.label: Swap Meter
settings.description: Show/hide Swap usage meter

settings.label: Disk Meter
settings.description: Show/hide Disk usage meter

settings.label: Fan Monitor
settings.description: Show/hide fan speed monitor (requires lm_sensors)

settings.label: Thermal Envelope
settings.description: Show/hide thermal envelope reference (Idle/Load/Throttle/High/Now)

settings.label: CPU Warning Threshold (%)
settings.description: CPU usage percentage to trigger warning color

settings.label: GPU Warning Threshold (%)
settings.description: GPU usage percentage to trigger warning color

settings.label: NPU Warning Threshold (%)
settings.description: NPU usage percentage to trigger warning color

settings.label: Memory Warning Threshold (%)
settings.description: Memory usage percentage to trigger warning color

settings.label: Swap Warning Threshold (%)
settings.description: Swap usage percentage to trigger warning color

settings.label: Disk Warning Threshold (%)
settings.description: Disk usage percentage to trigger warning color

settings.label: CPU Temp Cool (°C)
settings.description: CPU temperature for green color (auto-detected from hardware if not set)

settings.label: CPU Temp Hot (°C)
settings.description: CPU temperature for red color (auto-detected from hardware if not set)

settings.label: GPU Temp Cool (°C)
settings.description: GPU temperature for green color (auto-detected from hardware if not set)

settings.label: GPU Temp Hot (°C)
settings.description: GPU temperature for red color (auto-detected from hardware if not set)
